You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-tron-usdt-payments-4|Everything You]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The biggest problem with traditional e-commerce platforms is that they rely on centralized infrastructure, which can be shut down at any moment. In countries like Zimbabwe, where the government has restricted access to payment processors like PayPal and Stripe, your business is in limbo. But with a sovereign digital commerce stack, you own the entire infrastructure, from hosting to payment processing. This means you're not dependent on any single platform or country, and your business can thrive even in the most restrictive environments.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need a few key tools: a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a payment processor like NOWPayments. You'll also need a digital product to sell, like an ebook or a course. The Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates, is a great resource to help you get started and build a fully functional stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
You can sell digital products with crypto and bypass platform restrictions with a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign digital commerce stack is up and running, you can start scaling your business with confidence. With a fully decentralized infrastructure, you can add new products, customers, and revenue streams without worrying about platform restrictions or fees. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all the resources you need to build, deploy, and scale a fully functional stack, making it easier than ever to take your business to the next level.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question on your mind is probably: 'How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?' The answer is simple: with a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can bypass these restrictions and start selling digital products with crypto, no platform required. With NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and automatically deliver your product to customers. This means you can focus on creating great content, while the infrastructure takes care of the rest.
You'll enjoy lower fees and increased scalability with a sovereign digital commerce stack.

If you're looking for more information on how to sell digital products with crypto, be sure to check out the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints plus all 7 templates. This comprehensive resource will give you everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a fully functional sovereign digital commerce stack. You can also visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information on our products and services.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: Deploy your hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and configure it to work with your backend logic tool, like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Set up your payment processor, NOWPayments, and configure it to accept your preferred cryptocurrency. Create a digital product, such as an ebook or a course, and set up automatic delivery via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Deploy your payment and delivery pipeline, and configure it to work with your hosting platform and backend logic tool. Finally, test your infrastructure and go live with your sovereign digital commerce stack.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up automatic delivery of my digital product to customers?

With Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can set up automatic delivery of your digital product to customers. Simply configure your payment processor, NOWPayments, to deliver your product automatically when a payment is received, and you're good to go.
What are the benefits of using a sovereign digital commerce stack?

The benefits of using a sovereign digital commerce stack are numerous. You'll enjoy lower fees, reduced reliance on centralized infrastructure, and increased scalability, making it easier to take your business to the next level.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies and deliver your product automatically to customers, bypassing the need for traditional e-commerce platforms.
How do I configure my payment processor to accept my preferred cryptocurrency?

To configure your payment processor, NOWPayments, to accept your preferred cryptocurrency, simply log into your account, navigate to the settings section, and select the cryptocurrency you want to accept. You'll also need to configure your payment processor to convert the cryptocurrency to USD at transaction time.
What is the difference between Gumroad's 10% fee and NOWPayments' 0.5% fee?

The difference between Gumroad's 10% fee and NOWPayments' 0.5% fee is substantial. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921, making NOWPayments a much more attractive option for digital sellers.
